full_judgment:
5. The petitioner Abul Hashem filed an application on 28.7.82 before the court for being added as a party as defendant in the suit In the said application the petitioner stated he has purchased the suit property from the defendant No. 1 and 3, the admitted owner by registered kabalas dated 8.3.1978. Along with the petition the petitioner also filed the kabalas, rent receipts, M. R. R. Khatian showing mutation of his name and Photo of Hashem Market constructed on the part of the suit property before the court for consideration in support of his claim to be added as party. This application of the petitioner was not opposed by the plaintiffs or by any of the parties to the suit by filing written objection. After consideration of the materials and after hearing the parties the learned Subordinate Judge by his order No. 19 dated 10.8.1982 rejected the prayer of the petitioner to be added as defendant in the suit mainly on the ground that the suit is one for specific performance of contract of sale and the petitioner is not a necessary party in a case like this. Being dissatisfied with and aggrieved from the said order of the learned Subordinate Judge the petitioner obtained this Rule. 

 8. It is true that in a suit for Specific performance of contract the main issue to be decided in the suit whether there was an agreement between the parties to the agreement and the petitioner is not bound to make any body a party in the suit. In the facts and circumstances of the case the petitioner himself, to safe-guard his right, title and interest in the property which he acquired, has approached the court for being added as defendant in this suit. He has in support of his claim has filed two registered kabalas executed and registered by the admitted owner of the suit land. He is also supported by the rent receipts and mutation khatian.
